title: FedEx Strengthens Its Presence in Chile with the Opening of New Ship Centers in Santiago and Valparaíso
summary: The new locations in the communes of Maipú, Peñalolén and the Valparaíso Region, are part of the company’s expansion plan to increase access to its logistics services across the country.
body_markdown:
FedEx announced the opening of new ship centers in the communes of Maipú and Peñalolén, in the Santiago Metropolitan Region, and in the Valparaíso Region, as part of its strategy to expand its presence and strengthen its customer service network in Chile.


The new facilities will enable the company to expand its service coverage and bring its logistics solutions closer to customers and businesses in areas experiencing growing commercial activity. At these locations, customers will be able to manage domestic and international shipments and receive in-person assistance.


“With the opening of the new FedEx Ship Centers, we continue to strengthen our presence in Chile and bring our services closer to customers, particularly small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs), by offering faster transactions and a simple, personalized experience,” said Matías Reguera, managing director of operations for FedEx Chile. “Customers benefit from our extended business hours and efficient package drop-off and pick up services at our 59 FedEx Ship Centers, located from Arica to Punta Arenas.”


With these additions, FedEx continues to strengthen its infrastructure in Chile amid growing demand for logistics solutions and greater integration of local markets with international trade.


The expansion of its network complements FedEx existing operational capabilities in Chile, including its own dedicated flight connecting Santiago and Miami multiple times a week. The air route to the United States helps strengthen Chile’s international connectivity and facilitates the flow of imports and exports between Chile and more than 220 countries and territories across FedEx extensive global network.


To find FedEx Ship Centers in Chile, customers can visit[fedex.com/cl.](https://local.fedex.com/es-cl)
